A wisp of vapor escaping a shoulder-joint mid-test, drifting up across the chest plate.
A single warning-light pulsing red on the cockpit-rim, slow and steady heartbeat rhythm.
A stray spark hitting a coolant-puddle on the hangar floor, brief silver flash.
The echo of a distant alarm reverberating off the bay walls, swallowed by silence.
A drop of hydraulic-fluid hitting the concrete from the elbow-joint, dark circle spreading.
The ambient hum of engines spooling up, sub-bass pulse felt through the deck plating.
A mechanic dropping his wrench in the midground, the clang echoing into the rafters.
A crane-cable swaying gently in the residual draft of the bay-door sliding shut.
The mech's eye flickering on for the first time, amber glow steadying to gold.
A tear of coolant running down the chest-plate, catching the overhead strip-light.
A tiny kaiten-prayer-tag fluttering from the antenna in the ventilation current.
Cigarette-ash falling from a tech smoking on the catwalk, dissolving before it lands.
A dropped clipboard clattering at the deck-edge, papers fanning across the floor.
A small cat lounging on a scaffold-rail, watching the mech with perfect indifference.
A tiny origami crane folded and placed on the mech's foot by someone unknown.
A lone strobe flickering out at the back of the bay, darkness pooling in that corner.
A paper-lantern swaying in the bay-door draft, orange light brushing the knee-plate.
A bent girder from yesterday's overload still being welded, sparks low and quiet.
A paint-drip halfway down a freshly-resprayed shoulder, not yet noticed by the crew.
A tiny hand-print on the mech's calf where a child pressed their palm once.
A kettle steaming on a tech's portable hotplate, curl of white rising past the scaffold.
A robot-mascot-doll strapped to the cockpit-handle, worn soft from years of launches.
Koi circling a small tank a tech keeps on the scaffold, orange flicker in dim light.
A folded receipt pinned to a clipboard at the foot of the mech, edges oil-stained.
A discarded helmet tipped over at the mech's heel, visor dark, reflecting the bay.
